chunks: Muhammad ibn Ali ibn Mahbub narrated from al-Hasan ibn Ali al-Kufi, from al-Husayn ibn Sayf, from his brother, from his father, from Zayd Abi Usamah, from Abi Farwah, from Abi Ja'far عليه السلام, who said:
"The one who commits the obscene act, and the one who goes to a beast, his hadd is the hadd of the fornicator."

So the interpretation of these reports is one of two possibilities. One of them is that they are to be understood to mean that when the act is short of penetration, then there is ta'zir in it; and when there is penetration, then upon him is the hadd of the fornicator, just as the report of Abi Basir contains by restricting that to penetration, and in that is an indication that if it is short of penetration, the hadd of the fornicator is not obligatory. The other possibility is that they are to be understood regarding one from whom the act was repeated and the hadd was established upon him; without ta'zir, at that point he is killed, or the hadd of the fornicator is established upon him according to what the Imam sees fit, because we have already explained that the people of major sins are killed on the third or fourth time. On this basis, there is no contradiction between the reports.

key_terms.التَّعْزِيرُ: discretionary punishment imposed when the full hadd does not apply
key_terms.الزَّانِي: the fornicator, whose legal punishment is used as the point of comparison
key_terms.الْإِمَامُ: the authoritative ruler/judge who determines the applicable punishment in certain cases
key_terms.الْإِيلاَجِ: penetration, which determines the application of the legal ruling here
key_terms.الْبَهِيمَةَ: a beast; the animal involved in the prohibited act
key_terms.الْفَاحِشَةِ: the obscene or gravely indecent sexual act referred to in the report
key_terms.الْكَبَائِرِ: major sins, whose repeated commission is discussed in relation to escalation of punishment

ai.seo_question: How do Shia hadith reconcile the punishment for bestiality and related obscene acts with other legal reports?
ai.summary: This report states a legal ruling concerning one who commits an obscene sexual act or has intercourse with a beast, equating the punishment in the report to the hadd of the fornicator. The accompanying discussion reconciles related reports by distinguishing between cases involving penetration and those without it, or by applying the ruling to repeated offenses subject to the Imam's judgment.
